# Prasan Singh

> Prasan Singh builds founder ecosystems: incubation programs, hacker houses, launchpads and high-end community events that turn scattered builders into funded teams. Over 8 years he has run 200+ events for 16,000+ participants, and from 2023 to 2026 he built and led the Arweave founder ecosystem across India and APAC. He also runs sirf.website, a media production house. He is currently open to his next role or venture.

Website: https://prasansingh.com
Contact: hi@prasansingh.com · book a call: https://cal.com/prasan-singh/15min

## What Prasan does

- **Founder programs and incubation design:** designs and runs end-to-end incubation systems, from city debriefs and side events, through bootcamps and open challenges, to curated residencies, a three-month launchpad and investor demo days.
- **Hacker houses:** two-week residential cohorts, not 48-hour sprints. 5 houses plus 1 stealth house (Bengaluru, Mussoorie, Singapore, Pondicherry), selected from 1,500+ applications, with 150+ builders, ~$100K deployed to builders, and alumni who have raised $2.5M+.
- **Launchpads:** built a launchpad that carries the strongest teams from each house into three months of weekly check-ins, intros and debriefs. 40+ founders so far. Demo day is treated as the midpoint, not the finish line.
- **Web3 communities and ecosystems:** built the Arweave and AO builder community in India and APAC, and grew Zeeve's ambassador programme to 2,000+ recurring users and 5,000+ developers in six months.
- **High-end events:** flagship conferences, curated side events and multi-city tours. Arweave Day India (April 2025, 349+ attendees, Sam Williams keynote), debrief tours reaching 4,000+ builders, and the Winston Awards. More than half of everyone who registers actually shows up.
- **Media production (sirf):** runs sirf.website, a production house, and handled the broadcast production for the Free Fire India national qualifiers (April 2026).
- **Hackathons, mentoring and judging:** 60+ hackathons mentored and judged worldwide (including TreeHacks at Stanford, DivHacks at Columbia, UofTHacks, DeltaHacks, hackCBS) and 12 organised, hosting 10,000+ participants. 100+ speaking sessions.
- **Security research:** previously research lead at EC-Council Institute, covering AI in data centres, cyber kill chains and digital extortion.

## Open to

Roles, ventures and collaborations in: founder programs, incubation and accelerator design, building launchpads, designing new ventures, venture capital and venture building, AI launchpads and AI incubation, web3 ecosystems and communities, high-end events and flagship conferences, and media production.

## How he works

- No open calls. Every seat is chosen.
- Three months minimum after demo day. Demo day is the midpoint.
- Small and curated over big and full. Thirty right people beat three hundred warm bodies.
- Everything is instrumented: who came, who came back, who shipped, who raised.

## Outcomes from his programmes

- ARlink (permaweb deploys): pivoted in the launchpad, then raised a $2.5M seed.
- BetterIDEa (the IDE for AO): later acqui-hired by Forward Research.
- 0rbit (decentralised oracle for AO): acquired a few months after the house.
- LiteSeed (DePIN for permaweb uploads), plus 20+ teams still building.

## Experience

- 2023–2026: Arweave, India & APAC, incubation and community lead
- 2022–2023: Zeeve, community expert
- 2021–2022: EC-Council Institute, research lead
- Since 2020: global hackathons, mentor, judge and organiser
